CHAPTER.VERS: They that trust in the LORD as mount Zion, cannot be removed, abideth for ever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surroundeth his people from henceforth even for ever.

For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands to iniquity.
the wicked: Heb. wickedness
Do good, O LORD, to good, and upright in their hearts.
As for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: peace upon Israel.
